title: Law to educate on stopping unwanted advertising on property
summary: This bill would require the Sanitation Commissioner to run a public education campaign about a state law that bars unsolicited advertising on private property under certain conditions. The campaign would cover the law's rules, exceptions, sign requirements, penalties and how to report violations, and the department would post sample signs online for residents to download and print. If the state law is repealed, the Commissioner would have to educate the public about any replacement law serving the same purpose.
